title: Changing the Coverage Package During the Term of a Cardinal Personal Auto Policy
content:
A Cardinal Personal Auto Policy may change its coverage package during the term only where the current package allows a change during the term and the policy status is in force. Otherwise, a new package can be chosen only on the renewal offer.

## Conditions

1. **Package permission.** The current package must allow a change during the term. Cardinal Auto Essential and Cardinal Auto Basic do not; the four higher packages do.
2. **Status.** The policy status must be in force when a midterm package change is processed. The status is read from the record of the policy being changed. A bound, cancel-pending, cancelled, nonrenewed or expired policy does not qualify.
3. **Eligibility.** The new package must pass the package entry gates on the change date.
4. **Financial-responsibility filing.** A policy carrying a financial-responsibility filing may move only to a package that may carry a filing.

## Dating and premium

The change is effective today or on a later date within the package's endorsement future-dating limit. The premium difference is prorated under the midterm premium change standard. No endorsement fee is charged for a package change.

## Downgrades

A downgrade must leave no attachment the new package does not allow:

| Attachment on the policy | Required on moving to the new package |
|---|---|
| Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage, where the new package does not allow physical damage | Removed |
| Cardinal Rental Reimbursement option ranked above the new package's highest rental rank | Lowered to an allowed rank or removed |
| Cardinal Roadside Assistance option ranked above the new package's highest roadside rank | Lowered to an allowed rank or removed |
| Rideshare endorsement, where the new package does not offer it | Removed |

## Decision summary

| Current package allows midterm change | Policy status | New package passes its gates on the change date | Midterm package change |
|---|---|---|---|
| No | any | any | Not available; choose on the renewal offer |
| Yes | not in force | any | Not processed |
| Yes | In force | No | Not processed |
| Yes | In force | Yes | May be processed, subject to the downgrade and filing conditions |

Hypothetical: an in-force Cardinal Auto Plus policy moving down to Cardinal Auto Essential must remove Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage and any Cardinal Rental Reimbursement, since that package allows neither. It must lower any roadside option ranked above 1, and remove any rideshare endorsement.
